exposure: oral gabapentin (300 mg before CD and every 6 hours for 48 hours)
cohort: The study included 21 healthy singleton pregnant individuals, aged 18 years or older, who were undergoing cesarean delivery and planned to breastfeed.
finding: The study found limited neonatal exposure to gabapentin, with estimated relative infant doses less than 0.15% of the maternal dose within the first 48 hours postpartum.
